import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    payments = inputs["payments"].copy()
    
    # Initialize columns for tracking
    payments["reason_code"] = None
    payments["rejected"] = False
    
    # R1: amount IS NULL -> reason_code 'AMT_NULL'
    mask_r1 = payments["amount"].isna()
    payments.loc[mask_r1, "reason_code"] = "AMT_NULL"
    payments.loc[mask_r1, "rejected"] = True
    
    # R2: amount <= 0 -> reason_code 'AMT_NONPOS' (only if not already rejected)
    mask_r2 = (~payments["rejected"]) & (payments["amount"] <= 0)
    payments.loc[mask_r2, "reason_code"] = "AMT_NONPOS"
    payments.loc[mask_r2, "rejected"] = True
    
    # R3: currency NOT IN ('USD','EUR','GBP') -> reason_code 'CCY_INVALID'
    # (only if not already rejected)
    mask_r3 = (~payments["rejected"]) & (~payments["currency"].isin(["USD", "EUR", "GBP"]))
    payments.loc[mask_r3, "reason_code"] = "CCY_INVALID"
    payments.loc[mask_r3, "rejected"] = True
    
    # R4: country IS NULL -> reason_code 'CTRY_NULL'
    # (only if not already rejected)
    mask_r4 = (~payments["rejected"]) & (payments["country"].isna())
    payments.loc[mask_r4, "reason_code"] = "CTRY_NULL"
    payments.loc[mask_r4, "rejected"] = True
    
    # Split into clean and reject
    payments_clean_df = payments[~payments["rejected"]].copy()
    payments_rejects_df = payments[payments["rejected"]].copy()
    
    # For clean records: round amount to 2 decimals
    if len(payments_clean_df) > 0:
        payments_clean_df["amount"] = payments_clean_df["amount"].round(2)
    
    # Remove tracking columns
    payments_clean_df = payments_clean_df[["payment_id", "amount", "currency", "country"]]
    payments_rejects_df = payments_rejects_df[["payment_id", "amount", "currency", "country", "reason_code"]]
    
    return {
        "payments_clean": payments_clean_df,
        "payments_rejects": payments_rejects_df
    }
